title: Tyson and the Fish That Said Plop
description: A prankster Pokémon and a leaf-boat race.
subtitle: A prankster Pokémon and a leaf-boat race.

cover.alt: Squirtle popping up beside Tyson and Mom on the dock.

blocks.html: Tyson and his mom, Theresa, went to the pond. They wore life jackets and sat on the dock. Tyson cast his line. Plop!
A round head popped up. “Squirtle!” said Tyson. The little Pokémon waved. “Do you like to fish?” asked Mom. Squirtle nodded. Then it ducked under the water.

blocks.alt: Tyson and Mom on a wooden dock at a calm pond with Squirtle popping up out of the water waving hello.
blocks.caption: A round head pops up — Squirtle!

blocks.html: Tyson’s float bobbed. Once. Twice. He lifted his rod. At the end of the line was a wet leaf. Squirtle popped up and clapped. “That is not a fish!” said Tyson.

Squirtle looked at the leaf. Then it looked at Tyson. It gave a big grin. Tyson cast again. Plop! The float bobbed. Tyson reeled in. This time, he had a small twig. Squirtle clapped even harder. “Are you putting things on my hook?” asked Tyson. Squirtle hid its face. But Tyson could see its grin.

blocks.alt: Tyson lifting his rod to find a soggy leaf on the hook while Squirtle pops up clapping with a mischievous grin and Mom laughs.
blocks.caption: A wet leaf on the line — Squirtle claps.

blocks.html: Mom laughed. “I think we have a pond prank.” Tyson set his rod down. “I have a new game,” he said. Mom put a leaf on the water. It was shaped like a boat. “Can you push it to that reed?”
Squirtle blew a tiny puff of water. The leaf spun in a circle. “Too much!” said Tyson. Squirtle tried a soft puff. The leaf slid to the reed. “You did it!”

blocks.alt: Mom's leaf shaped like a little boat on the water near reeds while Squirtle blows a soft puff of water to push it and Tyson cheers.
blocks.caption: Squirtle puffs the leaf-boat to the reeds.

blocks.html: Then Squirtle gave one happy splash. Plop! A drop landed on Tyson’s nose. Mom held out a towel. “Did we catch any fish?” she asked. “No,” said Tyson. “But we found a very silly friend.”

blocks.alt: Squirtle making a big joyful splash at sunset with a sparkling drop landing on Tyson's nose while Mom holds out a towel.
blocks.caption: Plop! A drop lands right on Tyson’s nose.

blocks.html:

Plop!
